results.title: The Banner
results.overview: Rafael’s future depends on tonight’s event. But the event cannot start without the banner. And the banner is not ready yet.

results.title: This Isn't How I Pictured It
results.original_title: This Isn't How I Pictured It
results.overview: A young aspiring model has a very, very bad day, and starts to reconsider her career choice in the fashion industry.

results.title: Gatha Vaibhava
results.overview: Gatha Vaibhava is a fantasy drama that weaves together history, mythology, and destiny. When Purathan and Adhunika meet in the present, they embark on a mystical journey through their past lives from the divine realms of Devaloka to Vasco da Gama's voyage and the coastal lands of pre-independence Karnataka. As echoes of the past resurface, they must unravel their fate. Will love endure across lifetimes, or is history doomed to repeat itself?

results.title: East of Noon
results.overview: Set in a confined world outside time, East of Noon is the fable of prodigy Abdo (19) who uses music to rebel against his elders: showman Shawky (70), an eccentric showman who rules with a mix of performance and fear, and storyteller Jalala (75), who provides relief with stories of the Sea, which no one else has seen. East of Noon is a satire on the inner workings of an ailing autocracy and its inherent vulnerability to youth’s unchained vision of a better world.

results.title: My Favorite Love Story
results.overview: Near future in Seoul, Oliver and Claire are abandoned helper robots stuck in a rut. One day, Claire knocks on Oliver’s door to borrow a charger and they grow closer since then. Oliver hoping to meet his former owner again and Claire dreaming of seeing fireflies, the two decide to leave for Jeju Island. During the unexpected journey, they end up finding themselves falling in love. However, the joy of love soon fades away as Claire helplessly breaks down. With sad ending waiting for them, the two robots learn what love can bring.

results.title: Owambe Thieves
results.overview: A struggling married couple take a desperate gamble for survival. Their decision pulls them into a dangerous web of power, betrayal, and consequences they never saw coming.

results.title: Maten a Chico Fuentes
results.overview: Chico Fuentes catches a stray bullet after an ambush that killed his family. After healing he seeks revenge.

results.title: Arrival
results.overview: A man sees warnings about an ongoing alien invasion while he is heating up his TV dinner. It's all over the news. He panics and tries to warn his parents, but they don't believe it. Unfortunately, he therefore misses the warning not to open the door for anyone.

results.title: Down
results.overview: Marina and Anton, instead of leaving for the Maldives for their honeymoon, find themselves in an elevator stuck on the 12th floor of a high-rise building, along with a strange man in the form of a security guard who set up the breakdown of the elevator, longs for fair revenge and arranges a bloody fight over the guys reprisal.

results.title: La niebla
results.overview: Following a recent breakup, Selva returns to her childhood home. There she meets her mother, with whom she will share a weekend filled with recriminations, complaints, and also moments of understanding. The days they spend together will mark the end of one grieving process and the beginning of another.

results.title: The Gringo's 3
results.overview: The Gringo family just wants to enjoy a cozy vacation at home, but their plans collapse when their apartment building undergoes renovations. They're forced to temporarily relocate to the strange and infamous German District. While the rest of the family worries about having to adjust all over again, Erik secretly hatches a plan to still go on a sunny holiday. But his scheme backfires, landing him in a chaotic quarrel - and a hefty fine. To pay it off, he must work at a bustling bazaar full of quirky characters who keep finding new tricks to make him stay longer. The Gringo's will have to pull out all the stops, forge unlikely friendships, and come up with one outrageous master plan to break free - and finally enjoy their well-deserved trip to the sun.

results.title: Currents and Orders
results.overview: Shiny organic surfaces lead into a stream of movements and elements, a passage of time in which all earthly order appears to be dissolved. In shimmering orange costumes, three figures wander through a secret cave world. Their ritualized movements not only build up an occult tension but also conjure up something absent but possibly soon approaching in gestures of union.

results.title: The Shepherd Code: Road Back
results.overview: Alex Lapierre was once a professional assassin. He now leads a peaceful existence, far removed from his tumultuous past. However, the past never stays buried for long.

results.title: Stardom 5STAR Grand Prix 2025 - Day 10
results.overview: The tenth night of the tournament took place at Yokohama Budokan in Yokohama, Kanagawa, Japan on August 16, 2025.

results.title: The Assistant 2: A Family Affair
results.overview: Isaiah Parker is doing everything he can to nurture and care for his family, but worlds collide when a beautiful stranger comes into town, things become more than what he bargained for.

results.title: Maximina
results.overview: Massimina is a 56-year-old woman. Massimina is a sex worker. Massimina was born in Rome. Massimina doesn't believe in God... but she believes in Buddha. At night, she reflects on the ghosts of her past and attempts to push them away, with closed eyes in front of the altar. When her mind is crowded with thoughts, she walks by the sea. Massimina lost her brother. She lost many sisters in the streets. She has many clients... she goes to dinner with them, she calls them, has sex with them. Massimina has a great friend, her name is Denis. She also has a cat, Cirillo. Massimina fears no death... and she stares life straight in the eyes. Massimina is saintly and cursed. Massimina is sincere and a lier. Who is Massimina...?

results.title: I'll Get Back to You
results.overview: For the first time in decades, an exile arrives in Palestine and enters his family home. His mission is to recollect and liquidate remnants of the past. His expedition across the present connects him with places, people, and Palestinian plains. The plot thickens when his encounters lead him to a confrontation with Abu Bassam, a steward of the land, who reminds him that Palestine always remembers its people and keeps their roots alive. The exile’s mission transforms from liquidation to reincarnation, leading to a new state of permanence.
